answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 6 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The ridge chain is verified at intake and tide publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 6 epochs old, anchored at a mesa checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 316 aliases cost 314 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
